verdict.rationale: Trivy is an open-source command-line scanner with no graphical UI in the evidence (it is run as `trivy image`, `trivy k8s`, via brew or docker), so API-versus-UI parity is a category error for this product. The 404 OpenAPI probes and the separate MCP server do not create a UI whose features an API could mirror. The MCP evidence belongs to a different story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
